description: Donnée Ouverte sur la Bouche d'Incendie au Togo is a data set listed in Togo national open data portal (opendata.gouv.tg), a national open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Armées. Les données ouvertes sur la bouche d'incendie visent à suivre l’état des bouches d’incendie (fonctionnelles, en maintenance, endommagées) afin de garantir leur disponibilité en cas d’urgence et à aider les municipalités et services de secours à planifier l'installation de nouvelles bouches d'incendie dans les zones mal desservies. Coverage: Togo. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Armées. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-tg-portal.
